title: Men's Drummer – The Neighbors Love Me. Embroidered Zip Hoodie
who: the drummer who practices in the garage every night and is sure the whole street is a fan, zipped on for the load-in and the long drive home from the gig.
art: Three row houses in cream, red and sage stand side by side while a drummer in a plaid shirt plays a drum kit in the open garage of the middle one, a neighbor in a robe covers his ears at the left door, a woman covers hers at an upstairs window and an orange cat sits on the steps, in cream, coral, sage and navy with a worn print texture.
headline: THE NEIGHBORS
inks: coral and cream on Black and Navy, brick red and navy on Ash
layout_story: THE NEIGHBORS runs above it and LOVE ME. below in two huge lines of fat rounded capitals
layout_faq: THE NEIGHBORS above the row houses and LOVE ME. below
chest: a small LOVE over ME. wordmark in the same rounded capitals as the back
warm2: cold garage rehearsals, drafty load-ins and the drive home after a gig
gift_line: for the drummer who believes the neighbors secretly love the noise.
seo_desc: A drummer zip up hoodie: THE NEIGHBORS LOVE ME. on the back over a garage drummer and three annoyed neighbors, plus stitched LOVE ME. lettering on the chest.
